summary: Praxis Precision Medicines filed an 8-K announcing a research collaboration and license agreement with Remagine Labs to develop an iontophoretic transdermal patch for ulixacaltamide for essential tremor, plus an equity investment in Remagine. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring is involved—this is a routine product-development partnership. The registrant's role is issuer reporting an ordinary business agreement. The filing contains no deal terms (price, premium, close date, break fee). This is not a special situation; it is an R&D collaboration and licensing deal, reportable as 'Other Events' under Item 8.01. No risk-arb angle exists.
